findings.claim: FICO 為伊利諾州北區聯邦法院反壟斷集體訴訟被告；2026-09-29 簽訂和解條款書，擬付 6,500 萬美元並附合規承諾，不承認不當行為，仍待法院最終核准。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: On September 29, 2026, FICO and the plaintiffs entered into a term sheet memorializing the material terms of a proposed settlement of the lawsuits. In consideration of a cash payment by FICO to the plaintiffs of $65.0 million and certain compliance undertakings, the settlement would fully resolve all remaining claims asserted against FICO in the lawsuits.

findings.claim: 法院 2024-11-24 駁回除 Sherman Act 第 2 條及相關州法請求以外的所有主張，剩餘主張對 FICO 進入證據開示階段。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: The court dismissed with prejudice all claims in the lawsuit other than a Sherman Act Section 2 claim and accompanying state law claims against FICO, which were allowed to proceed through the discovery stage of the litigation.

findings.claim: FY2026 第四季已認列 6,500 萬美元和解負債，計入 SG&A 的外部服務費增加。
findings.excerpt: a $65.0 million liability recorded in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 for a proposed settlement of the antitrust class action lawsuits

regulatory_antitrust.note: 搜尋另見 2026 年多項監管壓力（Florida AG 於 2026-07-01 發出 CID、Hawley 2026-03-23 致函 FICO 與 FTC、FHFA 關於 VantageScore 與 tri-merge 的動作），僅取得搜尋摘要轉述，未取得可逐字原文，列為 clues。未確認 DOJ/FTC 2026 正式立案；未見 EU 競爭調查。

clues.claim: Florida 檢察長 Uthmeier 於 2026-07-01 對 FICO 發出民事調查要求（CID），調查是否違反 Florida Antitrust Act（綑綁、掠奪性定價、與信用局限制性協議）。
clues.source: PYMNTS/CPI：Florida opens antitrust probe into FICO

clues.claim: Sen. Hawley 於 2026-03-23 通知 FICO 國會調查其房貸信用分數漲價，並去函 FTC 要求平行調查。
FHFA 指示 Fannie/Freddie 開放所有貸款人使用 VantageScore，報導稱 FICO 股價單日大跌約 15–18%（二手來源）。
clues.source: TIKR：Fair Isaac stock drops after federal regulator vows to end credit bureau overcharging
